title: Research construction: eight-query private native shear batch (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

**Recursive-interface research construction with a scoped finite optimum. No new kappa.**

Batch four DATA targets and five immutable sources through one arbitrary-dirty private row using PR521's native ADDRESS query. For the explicit rank-three incidence matrix, sharing dirt correction reduces the best separately completed PR677 rank-factor schedule from **12 recursive queries and 36 XOR scans to 8 queries and 30 scans**. The eight queries include 48 ordered-affine events and all recovery children. No DATA row is queried, copied or cleared.

The package supplies the literal 38-event schedule, its arbitrary-array identity, a complete typed cost recurrence, nine source pins and exact verification. The eight-query lower bound applies only to the stated single-level excursion class. All **5,376** minimum-query schedules in that class are exhausted; **232** attain 30 XOR scans. A second enumeration through target-column bases reproduces the full histogram. This is not a general query lower bound or an admitted supplier.

Only six files under `research/native-shear-batch/` are added. Exact base: `bbc600db2fc15007b7c914f4f2b2ed55fa909c87`. OS-random assignment seed: **52**. The selected PR942 result and `upstream/` are unchanged.

## Reproduce and validation

```sh
python3 -I -B research/native-shear-batch/verify.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_NATIVE_SHEAR_BATCH schedules=5376 queries=12->8 xor_scans=36->30 columns=7290 negative_controls=8 no_new_kappa
```

Passed on macOS arm64 with Python 3.14.8, standard library only:

- Exact Laurent-polynomial endpoint and inverse; rational forward/inverse ADDRESS lowering.
- All 7,290 input columns on the full 729-address domain, including arbitrary private dirt; complete forward and reverse replay.
- Direct-map/literal-lowering agreement on every order-three and order-five ADDRESS, including spectators.
- Eight algebraic/admission/invoice controls, a paid neutral-pair control, and four actual certificate corruption controls.
- Normal, isolated optimized and two-file relocated execution; all nine pinned Git source hashes.
- `make selected-record-check`, all 17 selected-record tests, and staged whitespace/scope checks.

No repository-wide `make verify`, cold supplier reconstruction, hosted CI or Lean build is claimed. These finite replays are not a formal proof of the full multiplication theorem. Supplier placement, permission to retain the private batch state, complete row/route admission, all-size compilation, realization, hosting, tape and analytic transfer remain open. The recurrence goes from this batch interface to an ordinary interchange child; it is not a self-recursion proving an exponent.

## Predecessors and coordination

Credit Karl Appel / @applecrusher's #521 native lowering, @commdata2338's #677 restored shear contracts, @CubeJerry's #889 common-factor dirty correction sharing, and the inherited upstream stream contracts. No priority is claimed for compute/uncompute or dirty correction sharing. #938 audits a different star-word language. Concurrent #982 borrows an output instead of retaining a dedicated private row, a different scratch/query contract. #974's optimistic selected-supplier budget is not used to claim a bound here.

There was no pinned sprint issue, so `CLAIM.md` records the local claim, three candidate tasks and completed result. The immediate pre-submission open-PR refresh reached #989; no duplicate native private-only affine-state census was found. Upstream main advanced to `55645f9d4d806d67875c1c8b9840b0b039ece22e` with the same selected kappa and no package-path overlap.

Contributed by **Sagar Thakrar / @thakrarsagar**, with substantial **OpenAI Codex assistance** in mathematics, implementation, verification and writing. Apache-2.0; no independent human review is claimed.
